a.lede: Google is getting flak for its decision to publish Android developers' identifying information around the world to comply with European laws.
a.title: Google will soon share Android developers' addresses publicly

b.lede: Independent Android app developers are worried about their privacy after Google announced that from next year many of them will be required to share a phone number and address publicly. The policy change is intended to meet European Union regulations under the Digital Services Act, but Google says contact details will be made public worldwide. […]
b.title: Android app developers will soon have to share their address publicly
